Hi, I'm Tiansi. I'm a postgraduate student at Monash University, where I study how to analyse data and, just as importantly, how to explain what it means to people who did not do the analysis.

I'm especially interested in public health and policy questions, where good evidence only helps if decision-makers and the public can understand it. On this blog I take research findings and rewrite them as short, plain-language stories with clear charts and tables.

## Education

**Monash University**, Melbourne  
Postgraduate study · Department of Econometrics and Business Statistics

## Skills

R · tidyverse · ggplot2 · Quarto · data visualisation · statistical communication
